headline: Closed hearings on Revo casino and South Willow Street gas station plans; hired VHB for traffic review.
summary: Speakers both supported and opposed a 16-story building with 196 apartments at 99 Lowell Street, and that hearing was continued to November 5, 2026. The hearing on a parking reduction at 88 Pine Street closed, with action set for the October 15 business meeting.
decisions: Chose VHB to conduct the third-party traffic review of the casino studies.
Closed the public hearings on the Revo casino and gas station applications, to be scheduled for October 15.
Continued the Wellington Road subdivision hearing to November 5, 2026.
Continued the 333 Cohas Avenue lot line application to November 5, 2026.
Found seven applications complete and set them for public hearing.
Continued the public hearing on the 99 Lowell Street project to November 5, 2026.
Approved a waiver from Section 4.8.8.2 for the 88 Pine Street project.
Approved the September 3, 2026 minutes as amended, with two abstentions.
